titulo.estudio: Raconter une expérience : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: Telling an experience: Finding the details

intro: Follow a past experience and recognise the contrast between background and successive actions. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Follow a past experience and recognise the contrast between background and successive actions. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: the imparfait describes a situation or habit; the passé composé narrates completed actions. In this passage, «randonnée» means «hike».

frases.estudio: Quand j'étais enfant, nous passions souvent les vacances chez mes grands-parents.
frases.alumno: When I was a child, we often spent the holidays at my grandparents' house.

frases.estudio: Un été, nous avons fait une randonnée dans les Alpes et nous avons perdu le chemin.
frases.alumno: One summer we went on a hike in the Alps and lost our way.
